title: Football
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Creative Arts and Sports; not yet checked by a CBC Creative Arts and Sports teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Skills on the field; crayons made from candle wax and colour with a teacher.

skills.key_step: The child says trapping stops and controls the ball, dribbling keeps it close while moving, shooting sends it at goal with the laces, and crayon etching scratches a dark top layer.

floor.question: Which part of the foot stops the ball best?

steps: Shoot: laces, eyes on the ball.

misconceptions.repair: Trap a ball dead under the sole, then shoot; name each.
Dribble round cones alone, then pass; name each.
Scratch through a dark crayon layer to show colours.

misconceptions.ask: Which part of the foot gives a powerful, accurate shot?
misconceptions.repair: Shoot five with the toe and five with the laces; count on target.

checks.question: Which part of the foot is best for a powerful shot?
